scope: Independent primary assay/priorart/value gate for authentic EMC telomere-maintenance PHENOTYPE only
before_values: No new relevant numerical ALT/TRAP/telomere-length/protein outcomes inspected before this freeze; owner exact plan/roles pending coordination
claim_under_challenge: Can direct publicly measured EMC ALT or telomerase activity and paired phenotype/condition controls yield a new useful comparison beyond published prevalence?
source_gate: Original primary and supplements identify every EMC donor/condition, molecular/pathology authentication and overlap

Direct ALT threshold/positive-negative assay controls and denominator/evaluability; TRAP measures activity with extraction/inhibition/viability controls; telomere-length assay measures length not necessarily maintenance mechanism
Promoter mutation, wildtype, RNA or ATRX/DAXX retention are distinct proxy observations; none alone establishes telomerase activity or ALT absence
Published prevalence/primary direct assay may defeat novelty; authentic independent model/tissue comparisons require both assay suitability and useful purpose
statistic_gate: No new calculation proposed unless independent suitable individual assay values/condition links exist; a published denominator recheck is source validation, not novel finding. Models/tissue/donors must not be pooled as independent; no FISH image or graph point reconstruction.
controls: Assay-specific positive/negative controls, viability/preservation/core selection, tumour-cell identity and clinical grade/site/therapy; compatible known-ALT and telomerase-positive contexts only if direct assay exists
strongest_alternative: Missing mechanism-specific assay or already known prevalence; method sensitivity/tumour sampling, donor reuse or proxy interpretation creates apparent novel phenotype
disproof_or_stop: No authenticated useful paired direct measurement beyond published prevalence, important assay/identity gaps, or only restricted topology/RNA-surrogate route. Shelve this standalone paper without negative-absence or global-exhaustion claims.
next_measurement_decision: A valid new condition-specific assay comparison could select the appropriate direct maintenance assay/control for EMC research; no efficacy, vulnerability or intervention causation claim.
restrictions: Quiet ordinary files/API/PDF text only, no UI/images/FISH inspection before14UTC. No structural-genomics/topology/telomere-fusion architecture, FAP-tissue, glycan or HLA review. No bulkBAM/DNA,spend,outreach,publication,PR,root mutations/push.64MiB softcap/free10GiB; preserve freezes and caches.
